'''Taran_Wanderer Revamped Death Star Destuction''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Taran_Wanderer]]
* '''Published:''' 31 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / Echo Base Operations|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif|label=Massassi Base Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Massassi Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Massassi Base Operations Taran_Wan Revamped.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Change half the cards in my deck, please tell me if you think it's any good

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Basically this is a Space Supremecy Deck with the destruction of the Death Star thrown in for good luck.  Practically all of the characters can be drawn by other characters (pilots by Dodonna, leaders by Leia) and with Sqaudron Assignments, I should have little problems with getting ships out.  The fliped objective also lets me get to the neccesary Death Star Destruction cards easily.  Gospic will also help keep Imperials off the planet, along with Tigran Jamiro and the Objective.

The purpose of the large number of sites is to take advantage of the force drain modifier on the Objective, +2 at any battleground system where I have a pilot.  Of course, this dosen't work until after the Death Star gets blown up, so I would keep the systems in my hand.
